visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) View of the exterior of a Korean restaurant called "捌貳捌貳 KOREA FOOD" at night. The ceiling under the overhang is black with several bright, warm spotlights. A yellow slogan is overlayed at the center. No people are visible here. (2) Close-up on a pair of hands wearing clear plastic gloves carefully rolling a kimbap on a bright yellow cutting board. The roll is thick with rice, carrots, and other colorful vegetables. (3) A woman, presumably the owner, wearing a grey baseball cap, a black T-shirt with a line-art face, and a light blue surgical mask. She points at a menu on the table while speaking. The background shows a white wall with posters. (4) High-angle close-up of various Korean dishes: a plate of neatly sliced kimbap showing colorful cross-sections, and a black stone pot filled with a red, bubbling tofu stew garnished with green onions. (5) Two hands hold up two small yellow bottles of Yakult against a blurred background. The lighting is bright and indoor. (6) Extreme close-up of Mentaiko kimbap slices arranged on a black textured plate. The filling includes pink radish, orange carrots, egg, and green cucumber. (7) Hands in gloves spread rice on a sheet of seaweed, add a line of pink mentaiko paste, and fill it with julienned vegetables and eggs. The roll is then brushed with a shiny liquid using a silicone brush. (8) Close-up of a stone pot bibimbap. A spoon mixes the rice, meat, kimchi, and a fried egg together. Steam rises from the hot bowl. (9) A metal spoon scoops out a large piece of pork and soft tofu from a red spicy broth. A half-cooked egg yolk is visible in the bowl. (10) A white bowl of Jajangmyeon is shown. Chopsticks pull up thick noodles coated in a dark, glossy black bean sauce mixed with egg strips and cucumber. (11) Tteokbokki with melted white cheese being lifted with chopsticks, showing long cheese strings. The sauce is bright red. (12) Shot of a chalkboard sign outside the restaurant detailing limited-time lunch offers in Chinese characters. (13) A stack of three colorful Korean canned drinks (pear and grape flavors) are displayed on a table. (14) Interior shot of the restaurant showing clean white walls, minimalist tables, and stools. The space is well-lit. (15) Final exterior shot of the restaurant sign under a blue sky, followed by a screen with the address and social media handle.
